You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

ba mamaki faruwar hakan tsakanin su domin tun nan nigeria shugaba buhari yasan bakowane zai bashi kwarin guiwar cigaba da mulkiba musamman talakkawa duba da irin halinda mu talakkawa muke ciki fargabarmu a nan itace ya sake darewa kaddara ta auku ya mutu yabar da cizon yats

output.original_text: ba mamaki faruwar hakan tsakanin su domin tun nan nigeria shugaba buhari yasan bakowane zai bashi kwarin guiwar cigaba da mulkiba musamman talakkawa duba da irin halinda mu talakkawa muke ciki fargabarmu a nan itace ya sake darewa kaddara ta auku ya mutu yabar da cizon yats.
output.joy: Akwai abubuwan farin ciki da zasu faru a tsakaninsu, tun daga lokacin da shugaba Buhari ya san duka hakan yana baiwa talakkawa kwarin guiwa na samun ci gaba, duk da irin halin da muke ciki a yanzu, muna fatan cewa kaddara zata taimake mu, ko da ya mutu, zai bar mana dariya.
output.sadness: Ba mamaki faruwar hakan a tsakaninsu, domin tun daga lokacin da shugaba Buhari ya san hakan, talakkawa suna cikin wani yanayi mai wahala, a fargabarmu kuma, kaddara ya dauke shi, ya bar mu da ƙuncin rai.
output.fear: Hakan yana da ban tsoro, domin tun daga lokacin da shugaba Buhari ya san hakan, talakkawa sun kasance cikin damuwa, halin da muke ciki yana tada mana fargaba, idan kaddara ta auku kuma ya mutu, zai bar mu cikin takun tsayi.
output.anger: Wannan lamari yana da banƙyama, domin tun daga lokacin da shugaba Buhari ya san hakan, ya zama jarin talakkawa ba su da kwarin guiwa, duk da irin halin da suke ciki. Babu da za mu yi idan ya mutu, lamarin ba mai kyau bane.
output.surprise: Abin mamaki ne wannan lamari ya faru, saboda tun daga lokacin da shugaba Buhari ya san haka, talakkawa suna cikin wani hali ba suyi tunanin hakan ba, sai aka yi wannan mummunar kaddara, ya bar mu cikin damuwa.
output.disgust: Hakan yana ba daƙaru, domin tun lokacin da shugaba Buhari ya san hakan, talakkawa suna cikin sharrun yanayi, kuma wannan tāpiyeyar kaddara ta auku gare shi yana ba mu rashin jin daɗi.
